items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: But I was in my prime then. 50 piece orchestra. My brother Frank was in the band.

ctx.x: You have it. Well we hired a 50 piece orchestra. We each put up $1,350. The session started right in Carnegie Hall at midnight. And we went until six in the morning. And I did the whole three movements of the “Concerto for Doubles.” Alto sax, bass clarinet, clarinet. Then I did “Oodles of Noodles” and the “Fantasy Impromptu.” But I was in my prime then. 50 piece orchestra. My brother Frank was in the band. And I went to the office one day and he gave me a check for about $240. He says, “I’m going to send Ralph…
Yes. In fact I wanted to play just a brief thing here for you, okay? Let me see if I can get this piece up and perhaps you can tell me a little bit about it. We’ll just listen to.
